Dev.releaseNotes:
`chore` (`tests`): **Drop the tests re-running plain schema steps**:

- Removed the tests that re-ran a schema step's SQL, found by a version pinned per backend, and the `SchemaSteps` lookup behind them
- The data fix tests stay and clean up the released tables and columns by plain SQL

`fix` (`api`): **Read the assumed file count from `PercentageGroupSize`**:

- Removed the copy of `PercentageToFileCount` in the APIv3 `FileCrossReference`, which only knew exact percentages, so a file covering 95% of an episode now counts as one of one instead of unknown

`refactor` (`abstractions`): **Allow linking releases to entries of any source by metadata ID**:

- Typed the IDs of release cross-references as `MetadataGuid`s (`IDs`, replacing `ProviderIDs`), stored with the main entry first; schema steps rewrite the stored releases
- Releases link only series, episodes and movies, of any source
- Validated cross-references through plugin `IReleaseCrossReferenceValidator`s on save, the core's AniDB one first; corrections give IDs and optionally a range, and a range change is checked again by the validators that passed it
- Healed stored releases through the validators ("Download Missing Metadata for Files"), taking only their corrections
- Added lookups of releases and videos by any metadata ID, and `IMetadataVideoCrossReference`, one direct link per cross-reference to its main entry; seasons carry their episodes' links
- Added `IVideo.IsRecognized`, `IsManuallyLinked` and `IsInImportLimbo`: any stored release recognises a video, provisional included, a `User` release makes it manual, and limbo is a main entry or its series not readable yet; the sweeps, dashboard, APIv3 file filters, APIv2 `recognized` and the import scan follow them
- Added `IRelocationProvider.SupportsNonAnidbLinkedVideos`, off by default, for files linked only to other sources than AniDB; `SupportsUnrecognized` still covers unrecognised files and `SupportsIncompleteMetadata` files in import limbo
- Kept entries a release names in use for the purge and refresh, and listed their files in the entry and TMDB file routes; the APIv3 `File` and the file events carry their `MetadataCrossReferences`
- Queued the refresh of the series or movie of each entry of another source a saved release names, and included them in the bulk refreshes, image downloads and collection fetches
- Counted directly linked files on the calendar, kept such files' events from restricted users, used their entries' folders for relocation, and carried watched state between files of one entry
- Made `shoko-build` tag a plugin implementing a validator with `release-validator`

`fix` (`core`): **Skip a release provider suspended while searching**:

- A release search stops waiting on a provider that gets suspended while it searches, such as AniDB once its UDP login fails, and asks the next one, instead of failing or blocking the whole search
- The last provider is waited on and fails as before

`feat` (`api`): **Answer a 502 naming the release provider that failed a preview**:

- Added `ReleaseProviderFailedException`, thrown by `FindReleaseForVideo` when a provider fails the search
- `/api/v3/ReleaseInfo/File/{fileID}/AutoPreview` answers a 502 validation problem keyed `providerIDs[<provider ID>]`

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Test the database connection and set the default user through `ISystemService`**:

- Added `TestDatabaseConnection`, testing the current or given server settings with why it failed
- Added `SetDefaultUserCredentials`, refused outside setup mode
- `/api/v3/Init/Database/Test` uses the former

`refactor` (`abstractions`): **Replace the client data of video user data with user tags**:

- Replaced `IVideoUserData.ClientData` with `UserTags`, set through `VideoUserDataUpdate.UserTags` and `IUserDataService.AddUserTagsForVideo`, `RemoveUserTagsForVideo` and `SetUserTagsForVideo`, as for episodes and series
- Schema steps drop the `ClientData` column and add `UserTags`; nothing is carried over
- Removed the `/api/v3/File/{fileID}/UserData/ClientData` routes; the file user data and its SignalR event carry `UserTags`

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Let seasons carry resources and resources a title of their own**:

- `ISeason` is `IWithResources`, empty by default; providers write season links through `MetadataSeasonData.Resources`, stored with the season
- Added `Resource.Title` beside `Name`, the site or service
- APIv3 seasons and resources carry them, with a `Season/{id}/Resources` route

`feat` (`core`): **Add a "Download Missing Linked Metadata" action**:

- Queued a refresh of each series or film an anime in the library links to on an enabled provider's source that is not stored, and of the series of each linked episode not stored
- Queued the AniDB anime of linked series in the library that are not stored
- No default trigger, as for "Download Missing AniDB Anime Data"

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.131**.

`chore` (`buildtools`): **Bump build tools version to v0.9.1**.

`feat` (`buildtools`): **Add manifest write hooks for release extensions**:

- `shoko-build` runs `ShokoBeforeAssetWrite` once per runtime with the pending archive, then `ShokoBeforeReleaseWrite` once per release with the whole release, and takes back only their `extensions`
- `ShokoAfterReleaseWrite` runs once per release after the manifest is saved
- Nothing extra runs when no target attaches to them

`chore` (`buildtools`): **Bump build tools version to v0.9.0**.

`fix` (`hashing`): **Carry the 5.x hash types over on upgrade**:

- Added settings migration 33, which takes `Import.Hasher` out of the settings and keeps its `MD5`, `SHA1` and `CRC` in a carry-over file
- `VideoHashingService` turns those hash types on when it first seeds, then saves the seeded hashes and removes the file

`fix` (`plugin`): **Serve embedded plugin images from memory instead of writing them out**:

- A plugin's embedded thumbnail or icon is kept in memory and served through `PackageImageInfo.Data`, so nothing is written beside the plugin (an install under Program Files failed the plugin scan, and with it the start)
- An image that cannot be read only gets a warning, and the plugin goes on without it

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.130**.

`feat` (`abstractions`): **Report the web UI selection's automatic pick, host match and pinned settings**:

- `IWebUIService` gives `SelectedProviderID`, `AutomaticProvider`, `GetHostOverride` and whether an environment variable sets `IsEnabled` or the pick; `WebUIProviderInfo` gives `IsAutomatic` and `IsDefaultCandidate`
- `GET /api/v3/WebUI/Provider` reports them, with the request's host and the override matching it
- Saving the host overrides or the pick keeps an unchanged entry naming a web UI that is gone, and `PATCH` refuses to change a setting an environment variable sets

`feat` (`images`): **Validate the images of the whole collection, a group, a series, an episode or a video**:

- Added the "Validate Images" executable action at every level, with options for the sources, the types, reading the contents and re-downloading, and per level which related entities' images to include
- `IImageManager.ValidateImages` validates any set of images with `ImageValidationOptions`, shared by every level; `ValidateAllImages` and `ScheduleValidateAllImages` take the options too, the scheduled job carrying them

`docs`: **Name the orchestrator that queues the anime a saved release links**.

`fix` (`core`): **Stop reading media info when the job is cancelled or times out**:

- `MediaInfoJob` takes the job's cancellation, so a cancelled job or a server stop ends the read
- `MediaInfoUtility.GetMediaInfo` kills MediaInfo when cancelled or past `MediaInfoTimeoutMinutes`, where the timeout only stopped waiting and left it running

`fix` (`core`): **Start with blocked files instead of refusing**:

- Unblocking the server's files on Windows now covers its executables too, and a file it cannot unblock (e.g. no write access under Program Files) only gets one warning with the PowerShell line to clear the mark
- The start no longer fails on them: .NET loads files carrying the mark, as the server already had by the time it checked

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.129**.

`feat` (`abstractions`): **List the stored texts of given entries**:

- Added an `IMetadataTextManager.GetAllTexts` overload taking entity IDs, reading their stored texts straight from the store like the one over every entry: nothing from linked entries, no synthesized titles, no memo

`fix` (`abstractions`): **Mark `AirDateWithTime` as UTC and say when it is only a day**:

- `IEpisode.AirDateWithTime` now says a date-only source gives midnight UTC or nothing
- The AniDB episodes and the stored `Metadata_Episode` rows give it marked `DateTimeKind.Utc`

`fix` (`core`): **Stop the server on a thread of its own**:

- The host is stopped on its own thread once told to stop, not by the host's wait on the thread pool
- Shutdown and restart requests start the stop on their own thread too, or on the caller's when none can be started
- A service that does not stop within the shutdown timeout is logged instead of ending the process with an unhandled exception

`refactor` (`core`): **Read missing media info through a scheduled action**:

- Moved the start-up queuing of media info jobs for files without media info, or with an older `MEDIA_VERSION`, out of `VideoLocalRepository.RegenerateDb`
- Added the "Update Missing Media Info" scheduled action, run at start-up by default, queuing `MediaInfoMissingFilesJob`

`feat` (`buildtools`): **Collect third-party notices at build time**:

- Added `WriteThirdPartyNotices`, writing `third-party-notices.json.br` next to the assembly: the licences of the NuGet packages the build copies, less the host's packages and what they depend on, with a per-package cache a clean leaves alone
- A package with no readable licence is warning `SHOKO0201`, an error in CI; `ThirdPartyNoticeOverride` sets it by hand and `ThirdPartyNotice` lists assets no package carries
- The core lists its own packages the same way, with overrides for the ones that only give a licence URL
- Documented the targets and the file format

`feat` (`plugin`): **List the third-party notices of the core and its plugins**:

- Added `IThirdPartyNoticeService`, reading the `third-party-notices.json.br` files beside the core, in its web UI and in each active plugin's folder, cached per file until it changes
- Added `GET /api/v3/ThirdPartyNotice`, one section per plugin with its own licence first, and `GET /api/v3/ThirdPartyNotice/Text` for the texts by key, for signed-in users

`feat` (`queue`): **Carry holds and job type keys on the queue feed**:

- The `queue` feed's pools carry `IsHeld` and `HeldTypeNames`, and its running jobs `PoolName`, built as `/api/v3/Queue` builds them
- The feed pushes when `IQueueScheduler.HoldsChanged` fires
- `PoolStatus.HandledTypeKeys` gives the key `SetJobTypeHeld` takes for each handled job type, on the REST and feed pool models too

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.128**.

`chore` (`buildtools`): **Bump build tools targets version to v0.8.0**.

`chore` (`queue`): **Bump `Shoko.QueueProcessor` to `6.0.0-alpha.17`**.

`fix` (`api`): **Keep the lists of a holds body optional**:

- Made `Pools` and `JobTypes` of `Queue.Input.HoldsBody` nullable, as the other optional lists of APIv3 bodies are, since reading a body with an omitted member set it to `null` over its empty initializer

`refactor` (`queue`): **Share one pool status between the queue gauges**:

- The five pool gauges now read one status of the pools per collection instead of taking one each, since each status counts the waiting jobs under every pool's lock

`refactor` (`metadata`): **Merge genres and studios across sources in the metadata service**:

- Added `GetMergedGenres` and `GetMergedStudios` to `IMetadataService`, which merge an AniDB anime's genres and studios with those of its linked sources, with `MergeOptions` (source order, genre limit, excluded genres) read and set through it
- Moved the merge out of `SeasonAnimeBuilder` into `MetadataMerger`, and the source order out of `AiringScheduleServiceSettings` into `MetadataServiceSettings`
- Added `Genres` and `Studios` to `SeasonAnimeEntry`, which the season view now reads

`fix` (`airing`): **Say that a failed sweep chunk resumes where it was**:

- Corrected the `IsFinished` doc and the failure log line, which said a failed chunk ended the sweep

`feat` (`airing`): **Typed preferences and more detail on sweeps and refreshes**:

- Added `PreferredChannels` and `PreferredTracks` to `IAiringScheduleService`, read and set typed; the APIv3 routes use them
- Added `SweepID`, `SweepStartedAt`, `ChunkIndex`, `IsFirstChunk` and `NoProgressCount` to `AiringScheduleSweepEventArgs`, with the sweep's identity kept on `AiringScheduleSweepState`
- Added the `Unavailable` sweep outcome, for a provider throwing `MetadataProviderUnavailableException`
- Added `RefreshCompleted`, raised once per provider for every refresh, queued or waited on

`feat` (`metadata`): **List every studio and network, and report saved tags and AniDB people**:

- Added `IMetadataStudioStore.GetAllStudios` and `GetAllNetworks`, and `IMetadataTagStore.EntitiesSaved`
- Listed AniDB's own tags under `IMetadataTagStore.GetAllTags` for AniDB
- Raised `EntitiesSaved` for the creators, characters, studios and tags an AniDB refresh writes, beside the removals it already reported

`fix` (`images`): **Let browsers revalidate stored images**:

- Sent a stored image with its last write time and an `ETag` from that time and its size, so an unchanged image answers 304 once its `max-age` runs out
- Covers the APIv3 `Image` routes and the APIv2 image module, which share `ImageFile`

`refactor` (`api`): **Always map the SignalR hubs**:

- Removed `Web.EnableSignalR` (`SHOKO_API_SIGNALR_ENABLED`); `/signalr/logging` and `/signalr/aggregate` are always mapped

`fix` (`metadata`): **No longer link a series or movie on its year alone**:

- A date with no title evidence now rates only when it is close: first episodes within 3 days or aligned airing days for a series, a release within 7 days for a movie
- A candidate sharing only the year is turned away with its reason

`fix` (`metadata`): **Keep the source of the titles a group or a custom title relabels**:

- A group's copies of its member series' main titles, and the main titles a custom title demotes, now keep the `ID`, `EntityID` and `ReferenceID` of the title they copy

`feat` (`metadata`): **Add an action that re-judges the links made on dates alone**:

- Added the "Re-judge Date-Only Metadata Links" scheduled action, without triggers, which judges every series and movie link rated `DateMatches` or `DateKindaMatches` again from the stored entry by the current matching rules
- A link the rules no longer take is removed and its anime searched again on the source; one rated otherwise keeps its new rating

`misc` (`metadata`): **Run the stale people, studios, networks and collections refresh weekly**:

- Changed its default triggers from at start-up and every 24 hours to Thursdays at 03:00

`feat` (`queue`): **Hold worker pools and job types by hand**:

- Added `QueueHolds` and `IQueueScheduler.SetPoolHeld`/`SetJobTypeHeld`: a held pool or job type keeps its jobs waiting, shown as blocked, while the rest of the queue runs; once the pools are known, an unknown name cannot be held but can be released
- Kept the holds in `Queue.HeldPools`/`Queue.HeldJobTypes` across restarts, restored with `QueueHolds.Set`, keeping names the queue no longer has with a warning
- Added `GET`/`POST`/`DELETE /api/v3/Queue/Holds`, and `IsHeld` and `HeldTypeNames` to the pool status

`repo` (`deps`): **Remove the unused Application Insights package**:

Removed `Microsoft.ApplicationInsights.AspNetCore`, which no code used. It only pulled in the Azure Monitor exporter, `Azure.Core` and transitive OpenTelemetry packages.

`fix` (`core`): **Apply the default log levels when they change**:

`ApplyLoggingLevelRules` returned early unless `LogLevelRules` or `TraceLog` differed, so `DefaultFileLogLevel`, `DefaultConsoleLogLevel` and `DefaultSignalRLogLevel` were ignored on their own, including at startup.

`fix` (`anidb`): **Mask credentials in the request logs**:

`AniDBHttpConnectionHandler` logged request URLs unmasked at trace level, and `RequestMylist` and `RequestVotes` put the password in them. The UDP mask also had a missing alternation, so a session following a space was not hidden.

Moved the mask to `AniDBLogMask` and used it for both connections.

`feat` (`core`): **Add the telemetry settings**:

Added the `Telemetry` settings section and `DefaultOtlpLogLevel`, for exporting traces, metrics and logs over OTLP to a collector the admin runs. The endpoint is empty and every signal is off by default.

- `TelemetryExportOptions` checks the values, since environment variables skip the schema, and turns the export off with a warning rather than failing the start
- Settings migration 32 adds the empty section, because the environment variables of a section are only read when the file has it

`feat` (`core`): **Add the OTLP telemetry runtime**:

Added `TelemetryRuntime`, which exports traces and metrics over OTLP when the telemetry settings ask for it. It builds its own providers as soon as the settings are read, so it also covers the plugin upgrades and scan, setup mode and a failed start.

- Flushed at process exit within 3 seconds, the one thing every way of stopping shares, as the tray app never stops its host
- Sends no trace context to the services the server calls, including through the core's `CoreHttpClientFactory` handler, which is built before the settings are read
- Hides secrets in span attributes through `TelemetryRedactionProcessor`
- Leaves `/signalr` and requests without an endpoint out of the traces
- Warns at most once per 5 minutes when exports are failing

`feat` (`core`): **Export the server logs over OTLP**:

Added `OtlpLogTarget`, an NLog target handing the server's logs to the OpenTelemetry logger when `LogsEnabled` is on, since every log goes through NLog.

- Holds the first logs until the settings are read, then replays them with their original times or drops them
- Writes on the logging thread, so a log carries the trace of the span it was written in
- Follows the same level rules and `Settings.*` filter as the log file, at `DefaultOtlpLogLevel`, which applies live and is not widened by `TraceLog`
- Scrubs well-known secrets from the message, and never exports the logs of the export itself

`feat` (`queue`): **Add job spans and metrics**:

Added `QueueTelemetry`, giving every job attempt a span and a `shoko.queue.job.duration` measurement by job type, pool and outcome, plus gauges of each pool's jobs and workers. It only uses the runtime's own `ActivitySource` and `Meter`, so `Shoko.QueueProcessor` takes no new dependency.

- `TelemetrySampler` applies `JobTraceSampleRatio` to jobs and `TraceSampleRatio` to everything else
- A job's span keeps the type of its error but never its message or arguments
- A failing listener cannot change what happens to a job

`feat` (`queue`): **Link job spans to the span that queued them**:

Stored the W3C trace context of the current span on `QueuedJob` as
`TraceParent`, and linked each attempt's span back to it. A link rather than
a parent, since a job can run long after what queued it has ended.

- Added the nullable column in the `AddJobTraceContext` migration
- Captured nothing without a recorded span, so a link never leads nowhere
- Captured once per `JobChainBuilder`, so every step links to what created it
- Kept the value through re-queues, retries and priority raises

`feat` (`db`): **Add database spans and metrics**:

Added `TracingBatcher`, the non-batching batcher every backend already uses,
reporting each statement as a span and in `db.client.operation.duration`. It
is only used with `DatabaseSpansEnabled` and a signal to carry it, so an idle
server keeps NHibernate's own batcher.

- Implemented `IBatcher` again, as `ExecuteNonQuery` cannot be overridden
- Named operations from a closed list, so a hand-written statement cannot
  put anything else in a span name
- Added the EF Core instrumentation behind the same setting
- Removed statements from every span unless `CaptureDatabaseStatements` is on

`feat` (`anidb`): **Add AniDB spans and metrics**:

Added a span and `shoko.anidb.request.duration` for every request sent, timed
apart from `shoko.anidb.rate_limit.wait.duration`, and counted registered bans
in `shoko.anidb.bans`. Only a UDP command's name is kept, since its arguments
hold the credentials.

`feat` (`core`): **Add domain spans and metrics**:

Added spans for hashing a file, searching for a release and fetching an image,
with `shoko.video.hash.duration`, `shoko.video.hash.size`,
`shoko.release.search.duration` and `shoko.image.download.duration`, and
`shoko.suspension.active` for what is suspended. None of them carry a path, a
URL or an exception's message.

`docs`: **Describe the OpenTelemetry export**:

Documented the settings, the telemetry names, what is kept out of it and a
Grafana Alloy example in `Shoko.Server/Telemetry/README.md`, the conventions in
`CLAUDE.md`, and the plugin naming convention in the `Shoko.Abstractions`
README. Added the packages to `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`.

`feat` (`db`): **Add repository spans and capture query shapes**:

The statement spans said little beyond the operation, so they could not be
used to validate queries, and a cached repository's work around its
statements was not visible at all.

- Named statement spans after their table and added `db.collection.name`,
  `db.namespace` and `server.address`, set as a statement ends since
  NHibernate only gives a command its connection as it runs it
- Added `repository.populate`, `repository.save` and `repository.delete`
  spans to `BaseCachedRepository`, leaving its in-memory reads alone
- Turned `CaptureDatabaseStatements` on by default and added
  `SanitizeStatement`, replacing string and number literals with `?`, for
  statements from NHibernate and, through `TelemetryRedactionProcessor`, from
  EF Core and plugins

`feat` (`core`): **Keep the query of outgoing URLs on spans**:

The runtime cut every outgoing URL down to `httpapi?*`, which hid what was
asked for.

- Set `System.Net.Http.DisableUriRedaction` when traces are exported
- Added `ScrubUrl`, hiding the values of parameters whose name suggests a
  secret or a person, such as `pass`, `user` and `api_key`

`fix` (`core`): **Keep the spans of the default HTTP client**:

Setting `ActivityHeadersPropagator` to `null` kept `traceparent` off outgoing
requests, but also removed the runtime's diagnostics from the handler, so
nothing using the `Default` client reported a span: web UI updates, plugin
manifests and image downloads among them.

- Used a no-output propagator in `ConfigureDefaultHandler`
- Extended `OutgoingRequests_CarryNoTraceContext` to require the span

`feat` (`queue`): **Report jobs being queued as spans**:

A job only carried a link back to what queued it, so nothing in the queuing
trace showed which jobs it had created.

- Added a `shoko.job.queue {JobType}` span in `BuildContext`, with the job's
  type, priority and whether it is scheduled, but never its arguments
- Skipped it without a current span, so background work starts no trace per job

`feat` (`core`): **Report repository reads, cache lookups and hash providers**:

Reads of the cached repositories, the manifest and AniDB release caches and the
work of each hash provider could not be seen in a trace.

- Counted reads in `PocoCache` and `PocoIndex` as `shoko.repository.reads`,
  with a tally on the local root span written by `RepositoryReadsProcessor`
- Added `cache.lookup` spans and `shoko.cache.lookups` to `ReleaseManifestReader`
  and `AnidbReleaseProvider`
- Added a `video.hash {Provider}` span under `video.hash`

`feat` (`core`): **Export the telemetry of the plugins too**:

- Exported the traces and metrics of every active plugin from sources and meters named after its assembly, through providers built once `PluginManager` raises `PluginsLoaded`
- Narrowed the core's own to `Shoko.Server` and `Shoko.QueueProcessor` and the names under them, instead of any `Shoko.*`
- Described how a plugin reports telemetry in the plugin README

`refactor` (`core`): **Always keep the OTLP log target in the logging targets**:

- Added the OTLP log target through the logging targets like the others, and made it required, as it is always created

`feat` (`core`): **Check and group the telemetry settings for clients**:

- Refused a bad `Telemetry.Endpoint`, `Headers` or an empty `ServiceName` in `ServerSettings.Validate`, on load and save
- Named the `TelemetryProtocol` values "HTTP/protobuf" and "gRPC"
- Hid `CaptureDatabaseStatements` until `DatabaseSpansEnabled` is on
- Split the section into Collector, Signals, Sampling and Database

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.127**.

`chore` (`queue`): **Bump `Shoko.QueueProcessor` to `6.0.0-alpha.16`**.

`fix` (`buildtools`): **Report a list of rows drawn inline by default without a key**:

- Reported `SHOKO0004` for a list of class items with no `[List]` display type or left on `Auto`, which the schema generator draws inline
- Accepted an item holding a `TitleComponent` as keyed, and treated converter-serialized types as single values, as the generator does

`chore` (`buildtools`): **Bump build tools analyzers version to v0.2.1**.

`fix` (`hashing`): **Remove the video record a rehash leaves without a location**:

- Removed the record a file's location left when a rehash put it on another record, once no location points at it
- Kept a record that still has another copy

`fix` (`plugin`): **Keep a repository's own stale time on start**:

- Applied `RepositoryStaleTimeOnStart` only to repositories without a stale time of their own

`refactor` (`plugin`): **Read a repository's manifest as one package or a list of packages**:

- Left out entries without a name, and read a package listed twice once
- Dropped `type` and `url` from `manifest.schema.json`

`feat` (`plugin`): **Queue package installs and share duplicate installs**:

- Ran installs one at a time through a queue of their own, usable before the scheduler is up
- Gave each entry a UUIDv5 of its plan, so a request for a queued plan joins it and shares its result
- Added `QueueInstall`, `WaitForInstall`, `CancelInstall` and `GetInstallQueue`, with `?immediate=true` and `DELETE /api/v3/Plugin/Package/Install/Queue/{entryID}`
- Carried the queue entry ID and actor on the install events, and sent the queue's events on the `plugin` feed

`feat` (`plugin`): **Add archive sizes to package manifests and the installed size of plugins**:

- Added optional `packed_size` and `unpacked_size` to archives, written by `shoko-build`, as `PackageArchiveInfo.PackedSize` and `UnpackedSize`
- Refused a download of another packed size, and an archive unpacking to another size
- Refused a plan, and each install, without the free space for it, unless `Plugins.Updates.IsFreeSpaceCheckEnabled` is off
- Downloaded archives to the cache folder, and unpacked them file by file, refusing entries outside the plugin's folder
- Added `LocalPluginInfo.InstalledSize`, measured from the plugin's folder or DLL and the files named after it, or the core plugin's from the app folder without `plugins` and `webui`

`chore` (`buildtools`): **Bump build tools version to v0.8.4**.

`chore` (`abstractions`): **Bump abstractions version to v6.0.0-alpha.126**.

`fix` (`abstractions`): **Read the `sdh` track tag as no language instead of reporting it**.

`fix` (`filters`): **Keep fuzzy scores for the most recent queries only**:

- `FuzzySearchService` held a score for every query ever searched, a few MiB each on a large collection, for the life of the process
- It now keeps the 16 most recently used queries and drops the oldest, with the name sets still held weakly

`refactor`: **Add `IsAllowedToSee(IVideo)` to `IUser` and drop `AllowedVideo`**:

- A recognized video is visible when any of its series is, and an unrecognized one only to users without restricted tags
- Every file listing, search and action check now uses it, so unrecognized files are hidden from restricted users everywhere

`fix` (`api`): **Restrict the file action and link routes to admins**:

- `Ignore`, `Variation`, `AVDump`, `Rescan`, `Rehash`, `AddToMylist` and the AniDB file `Rescan`
- The deprecated `Link`, `LinkFromSeries` and unlink routes

`refactor` (`api`): **Replace the unused `autoWatch` segment of the APIv2 `/Stream` routes with a placeholder**.

`refactor` (`api`): **Remove the APIv2 `/Stream/Filename` routes**.

`fix` (`api`): **Restrict the text management routes to admins**.

`fix` (`api`): **Restrict the APIv2 folder, import, rescan, rehash and queue routes to admins**.

`fix` (`api`): **Check restricted tags on the APIv2 file, episode and series lookups**:

- `file?id=`, `file/unsort`, `ep/getbyfilename` (v2.0), `ep/getbyhash`, `serie/fromep`, `serie/fromaid`, `serie/byfolder`, `serie/infobyfolder` and `links/serie`
- `file/count` and `serie/count` count only what the user may see

`fix` (`api`): **Read the signed-in user on the APIv2 dashboard**.

`fix` (`api`): **Restrict group editing, the AVDump batch, AniDB refreshes and the TMDB auto search to admins**:

`POST`/`PUT`/`PATCH` `/Group`, `/Group/{id}/Recalculate`, `/AVDump/DumpFiles`, both `/Series/…/AniDB/Refresh` routes and `POST /Series/{id}/TMDB/Action/AutoSearch`.

`fix` (`settings`): **Mask the database and queue connection strings as secrets**.
